scenario.en: Annotation selection/projection one-to-one relation
scenario.zh: Annotation selection/projection 一一对应

positive.en: Two authorized annotation_content items A and B selected once in canonical order bind one same-index/same-mode projection each. In portable_backup, A's projection PA has recordPin byte-equal to inputCatalog.items[contentSelection.annotationInputs[i].inputIndex].payload.recordPin and that pin selects A's exact canonical PortableAnnotationRecord/4; hidden target context does not suppress readable R6 body/attribution. All unrelated Document/View slots are empty/null.
positive.zh: 两个已获权 annotation_content 条目 A、B 按规范顺序各选一次，必须分别对应相同 index/mode 的唯一投影。portable_backup 的 A 投影 PA，其 recordPin 必须逐字等于 inputCatalog.items[contentSelection.annotationInputs[i].inputIndex].payload.recordPin，且该 pin 选择 A 的精确 canonical PortableAnnotationRecord/4；target context 隐藏不影响可读 R6 正文与署名。无关 Document/View 槽位必须为空或 null。

negative.en: Select A at the correct index but substitute B's independently authorized PB recordPin: reject even when both pins appear in the complete recursive union. Reject [0,1,0], duplicates, cross-mode/mixed modes, missing/extra projection, backup flags true, unauthorized domain/body selections and review_bundle_r6 with annotation_backup target. No pin-union substitution, supplemental read or projection repair.
negative.zh: 选择 A 的正确 index 却把投影 recordPin 换成独立获权的 B/PB：即使两份 pin 都存在于完整递归并集也必须拒绝。还须拒绝 [0,1,0]、重复 index、mode 不配或混用、缺失/多余投影、backup context flag=true、跨域或普通正文选择及 review_bundle_r6 配 annotation_backup；不能用 pin 并集、补读或改写投影来补救。

scenario.en: View result/layout/scope relation
scenario.zh: View result、layout 与 scope 关系

positive.en: With current entry authorization, a valid caller-selected viewInput names one existing catalog query_result containing a genuine D7ResultPin; only then run original D7 View §7 closed decode→result authorization/epoch→complete→schema→layout/binding→structure/order→domain/numbers→budget→delivery. A first bar(state,task_count)→PDF succeeds with complete_data same-data accessible table; the three resultInput values agree, renderer.layout=ViewSpec.layout, and projection.view.viewSpecSha256=viewRenderBinding.viewSpecSha256=SHA-256(D3-CJ/3(exact ViewSpec/1)). Print receipts resolve only their original authenticated confirmed protected print Plan and exact output/loss.
positive.zh: 现任入口获权且请求所选 viewInput 确实指向已有目录 query_result、含真实 D7ResultPin 时，才按原 D7 View §7 封闭解码→result 授权/epoch→完整→schema→layout/binding→结构/顺序→domain/numbers→budget→交付的顺序执行。首次 bar(state,task_count)→PDF 可携完整 complete_data 同数据可访问表成功；三个 resultInput 相等，renderer.layout=ViewSpec.layout，projection.view.viewSpecSha256=viewRenderBinding.viewSpecSha256=SHA-256(D3-CJ/3(精确 ViewSpec/1))。print receipt 只能关联原经认证且确认的受保护 print Plan 及真实 output/loss。

negative.en: Authorized caller-selected viewInput=99 missing in the catalog or caller selecting field/annotation_content instead of query_result returns the ORIGINAL D9/2 wire2 {wireVersion:2,kind:d9_error,code:invalid_request} before D7, not a fabricated D7 error or invalid_output from any worker/Host/Core output-validation path. A previously authenticated protected saved/frozen Plan with actually reachable proved contradictory index/kind/pin uses wire2 integrity_conflict only with that positive proof. Unproved/missing pin/evidence uses proof_unavailable; unavailable source/Observation uses source_unavailable; unavailable domain retains applicable domain_unavailable/original-owner result. Lost entry authorization plus bad index/layout yields original nondisclosing not_visible/reset first. With real selected result, D7 owner errors outrank D9 layout/renderer; no reread/requery/rewrite. Separately, original S33 positive output-coverage oracle remains: a worker reports success and IR schema validates, but a Host/Core independent coverage check finds a missing XLSX sheet or hidden object, so the original invalid_output applies. The original D9 Resource Region new-issuance format/geometry validator also keeps its applicable invalid_output; neither is the caller View selector path, and not every Host/Core failure shares this code.
negative.zh: 获权请求方选择目录中不存在的 viewInput=99，或选中 field/annotation_content 而非 query_result，必须在进入 D7 前返回原 D9/2 wire2 {wireVersion:2,kind:d9_error,code:invalid_request}，不能虚构 D7 error，也不能从 worker/Host/Core 的输出验证路径借用 invalid_output。已有经认证的 saved/frozen 受保护 Plan 若其 index/kind/pin 在可达证据中确实证明相互矛盾，才可使用原 wire2 integrity_conflict；pin/proof 缺失或不能证明时用 proof_unavailable，真实 source/Observation 不可得用 source_unavailable，domain 不可用按原 domain_unavailable/owner 处置。失权加坏 index/layout 先返回原不披露的 not_visible/reset。真实选中 result 时 D7 owner 错误先于 D9 layout/renderer；不得补读、重跑或改写。 另一条独立 S33 输出覆盖判据仍成立：worker 成功、IR schema 合格，但 Host/Core 独立覆盖校验发现 XLSX 漏 sheet 或隐藏对象，仍须按原 invalid_output 拒绝。原 D9 Resource Region 新签发的格式/几何校验也保留其适用的 invalid_output；两者均非请求方 View selector 错误，且并非所有 Host/Core 错误都使用该码。

scenario.en: View target, destination and receipt compatibility
scenario.zh: View target、destination 与 receipt 兼容

positive.en: For six-chart View, renderer targetKind/profileId equal the outer Plan target. Print uses a protected confirmed Plan resolved by receipt.planToken with Plan.target.kind=print and Plan.destination.kind=print, and D9PrintReceipt/1 repeats byte-equal View binding, actual staged print output and confirmed loss; its wire has no target field. External bundle uses PublicationReceipt/4, Resource uses only D7/D3 author result, server download uses delivery state.
positive.zh: 六图表 View 的 renderer targetKind/profileId 等于外层 Plan target。打印回执的 planToken 解析到原受保护且已确认的 Plan，该 Plan.target.kind=print、Plan.destination.kind=print；D9PrintReceipt/1 的 View binding 逐字相等，实际 staged print output 与已确认 loss 均对应，回执 wire 不含 target 字段。外部 bundle 使用 PublicationReceipt/4，Resource 只产生 D7/D3 author result，server download 保留交付状态。

negative.en: Reject wrong Plan association found only by matching token text, non-print Plan target/destination, wrong print receipt binding/output/digest/loss, mismatched renderer target/profile, print/non-print destination contradiction, or PublicationReceipt/4 substituted for print/Resource. Never compare a nonexistent receipt.target or add a duplicate target field; a View receipt cannot carry D8 document presentation.
negative.zh: 仅凭 token 文本关联另一份 Plan、Plan 的 target/destination 不是 print、print receipt 的 binding/output/digest/loss 不对应、renderer target/profile 不同、print 与非 print destination 混配、用 PublicationReceipt/4 替代 print/Resource，均必须拒绝。不得比较不存在的 receipt.target 或增添重复 target 字段；View receipt 也不能携带 D8 文档 presentation。

scenario.zh: fresh export /4 与历史 /1-/3 分派

positive.en: Fresh Plan4 dispatch is exactly eight D9ExportInputDomain/2 values: document→D6/D2 source_read; resource→resource_read; native_table→qualified D2 table and selected narrow D4 Field/Resource; node_collection→real complete Collection/Query producer with selected narrow Field; query_rows and query_json→complete D7 result, including full graph; annotation→one current D8AnnotationReadResponse/1; view→selected real D7ResultPin plus View §7 and accepted renderer. All seven catalog arms document/resource/field/annotation_index/annotation_content/template/query_result retain their actual producer; field is not a public ninth domain, annotation_index only supports authorized omissions, and template/route/style/asset/Resource dependencies are independently checked only when consumed. Existing saved/planned/unknown and inspect/confirm/publish/receipt use their authenticated protected Plan token/version/pins; only fresh unseen privately allocates a unique planToken after name preflight but before referencing report/manifest/Plan, atomically saving before disclosure.
positive.zh: fresh Plan4 只能分派八个 D9ExportInputDomain/2 值：document→原 D6/D2 source_read；resource→resource_read；native_table→获权 D2 table 及实际选用的窄 D4 Field/Resource；node_collection→真实完整 Collection/Query producer 与所选窄 Field；query_rows 和 query_json→完整 D7 result（包括完整 graph）；annotation→一次现任 D8AnnotationReadResponse/1；view→真实所选 D7ResultPin、原 View §7 与具名 renderer。document/resource/field/annotation_index/annotation_content/template/query_result 七种 catalog arm 各自保留真实 producer；field 不是第九个公开域，annotation_index 只用于获权省略目录，template/route/style/asset/Resource 依赖只在实际消费时分别检查。已有 saved/planned/unknown 与 inspect/confirm/publish/receipt 用真实经认证的受保护 Plan token/version/pin；唯首次 unseen 才在名称预检后、report/manifest/Plan 引用前私下分配唯一 token，并在披露前原子保存。

negative.en: Reject any blanket D8/D7 read for Source/Resource/Field, Query-backed Collection using a partial page or missing positive/negative dependencies, unqualified table/Field/template/asset reads, field as invented public inputDomain, annotation_index as content, or hidden/unused catalog arms as permission. Do not require a prior Plan to create one, add a second store/CAS, or migrate/repin/re-encode any original Plan/Receipt1–3, Catalog2, Selection1, Projection1, Loss1, Confirmation1, bundle1, OperationId or saved/planned/unknown bytes.
negative.zh: 不得对无关 Source/Resource/Field 强制 D8/D7 读取，不得让依赖 Query 的 Collection 用部分分页或遗漏正负依赖，不得越权读取 table/Field/template/asset，不得新设公开 field 域、把 annotation_index 当正文，或用未消费的 catalog arm 扩权。不能要求已有 Plan 才能建 Plan、添加第二 store/CAS，或迁移、repin、重编码原 Plan/Receipt1–3、Catalog2、Selection1、Projection1、Loss1、Confirmation1、bundle1、OperationId 或 saved/planned/unknown 字节。
